items.briefing:
Australian and New Zealand small businesses are rapidly adopting AI tools, but a new Arctic Wolf report finds trust in those tools remains low — and for good reason. Netskope is warning that data breaches caused by AI systems passing sensitive information downstream are rising sharply. Staff using AI tools at work may unknowingly expose client or organisational data through these platforms.

Fintech leaders are also calling for a more coordinated approach to payments security as AI grows in that sector. If your organisation uses AI tools, now is a good time to review what data staff are entering into them.

**Tip:** Remind staff never to paste sensitive client or student information into public AI tools like chatbots.

featured.title: ANZ SMEs adopt AI widely, but trust lags, Arctic Wolf report finds
featured.quote: Australian SMEs adopt AI widely but lack trust, creating security and compliance risks locally.
